rags pa rgya che ba phyi brten 'brel gyi yang dag par spong ba bzhi dang*/ phra ba nang rten 'brel gyi yang dag par spong ba bzhi'o/ /dang po la dbang blang ba'i yul sprul sku las rnam par rtog pa thams cad yang dag par spong ba/ dbang rang gi ngo bo tshogs pa'i mig gis ya gyal la btags/ len mkhan gyi gang zag tshogs lam chen po la gnas pa'o/ /bla ma'i rten dge soXgs pad can bcu gnyis ma las/ rnam par rtog pa thams cad spong bas yang dag par spong ba bzhi'o/ /de'ang bzhi pa rten can len pa yin te/ rig pa'i dbang re re'i gnas skabs na yang*/ spang bya spong tshul la bsams te skye ba lugs 'byung gi dga' ba bzhi/ yon tan skye tshul la bsams te thim pa lugs bzlog gi dga' ba bzhi'o/ /rang rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi gnas skabs su/ rtsa g.yas kyi nus pa thams cad g.yas ro ma la bsdu/ g.yon gyi nus pa thams cad rkyangs ma la bsdu/ yi ge'ang g.yas kyi bsam gtan gyi oṃ la/ g.yon gyi snying po'i a la/ khams kyang g.yas g.yon gyi nyi zla gnyis la/ rlung thams cad ldang 'jug la bsdu zhing*/ rlung sems kyi nus pa thams cad lte ba'i gnas su 'tshogs | de nas dbu ma'i mdud pa med pa sor bzhi pa'i phyi logs la drod dang rtse mo/ nang logs la bzod pa dang chos mchog gi rtogs pa skye/ de'ang lte ba'i gnas nas rlung sems 'thab/ sor phyed thur du bskyod pas drod chu rgyun phyed du bskyod pas drod 'bring ngo*/ /phyed bskyed pas chen po'i drod tshad chen pos so | | spang bya bzhi cha zhi la bzhi gsum ma zhi/ kun nas nyon mongs pa la brten pa'i gzung rtog go /lam du 'byongs na nyan thos kyi lam chod/ gol na 'dod khams su gol/ sku bzhi las rtogs pa dang shes rab thob pas chos sku'i dbang*/ dga' ba bzhi las dga' ba'i ye shes/ yang mtheb sor phyed thur du bskyod rtse mo chung ngu*/ phyed bskyod pas 'bring po/ phyed bskyod pas chen po'i chung ngu*/

phyed bskyod pas chen po'i chen po'o/ /spang bya gzung rtog gnyis phyed zhi la phyed ma zhi/ 'dzin rtog go /lam du slong na rang sangs rgyas kyi lam chod/ zhen na gzugs khams su gol/ sku bzhi las longs sku'i dbang*/ dga' ba bzhi las mchog dga'i ye shes/ dbu ma'i ma snar rlung sems thams cad phyin pas/ rtse mo chen po dngos su 'byung*/ gzhan gsum shugs las 'byung ste/ nang gi sangs rgyas rnams kyi lam srid pa'i rtse mor phyin cing*/ zhes bsten pas zhes gsung*/ dbu mar sems rtog med log sems 'phos pas bzod pas zhes pas bzod pa chung ngu dngos su 'byung*/ de'ang rtsa dbu ma'i nang na yar/ mtheb sor phyed gyen du bskyod pas bzod pa chung ngu*/ phyed bskyod pas 'bring po/ phyed bskyod pas chen po'i chung ngu*/ phyed bskyod pas chen po'i chen po'o/ /spang bya bzhi gsum zhi la snga cha ma zhi/ gzung rtog gnyis dang 'dzin rtog go /lam du slong na pha rol tu phyin pa'i lam chod/ zhe na gzugs med du gol/ sku bzhi las sprul sku'i dbang*/ dga' ba bzhi las dga' bral gyi dga' ba/ 'khor ba'i chos las 'das shing*/ mya ngan las 'das pa'i lam chos rnams yongs su rdzogs pas chos rnams kyi nang na mchog go /zhes pas chos mchog chen po dngos su 'byung*/ gzhan gsum shugs las 'byung ste/ de'ang mtheb sor phyed gyen du bskyod pas chos mchog chung ngu*/ phyed bskyod pas 'bring po/ phyed bskyod pas chen po'i chung ngu*/ phyed bskyod pas chen po'i chen po'o/ /spang bya gzung 'dzin mtha' bdun spangs/ gol sa med/ gsang sngags kyi lam chod/ sku bzhi las ngo bo nyid kyi sku'i dbang*/ dga' ba bzhi las lhan skyes/ khams 'dus pa tha ma la mdor bstan pa/ sprul sku las dbang gsum gyi rjes la byung zhes pa/ dge sogs pas rgyas par bshad/ chos mchog chen po sbyor te mjug bsdu ba ru gsum gnyis su gsungs/

spyir lam thams cad zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zung du 'jug pa las skye zhing*/ bye brag tu gsang sngags pas lam lus la bgrod pas/ gsang gnas kyi aṃ du rlung sems 'dus pa las/ nyer bsdogs yod la byed pa bdun gyi nyams skye ste/ de yi'ang mtshan nyid rab tu rig pa/ mos pa las byung zhing gnas dang*/ dben pa/ dga' ba sdud pa dpyod pa ba/ sbyor ba pa/ 'bras bu'i yid la byed pa'o/ /lte ba'i bsam gtan gyi aṃ du rlung sems 'dus na/ rtog pa med la dpyod pa tsam gyi ting nge 'dzin/ ya tshed sangs sogs rten dkyil 'khor bzhi'i gnad kyis/ bsam gtan dang po na bzhi'o/ /snying khar dga' ba dang bcas shing bde ba dang bcas pa'i ting nge 'dzin bde chen sogs/ bsam gtan gnyis pa na bzhi'o/ / mgrin par dga' ba med cing bde ba tsam gyi ting nge 'dzin/ dge ba la sogs bsam gtan bzhi'o/ /spyi bor btang snyoms yongs su dag pa'i ting nge 'dzin/ sprin med 'od sogs bsam gtan bzhi pa na bzhi'o/ /de yang dga' ba re re la bzhi bzhi yod pa dang*/ 'byung chung bcu drug gi gnad kyis/ gzugs med skye mched rigs bzhi la yang bcu drug tu 'gro gsung*/ mdor na bsam gtan gyi aṃ du rlung sems 'dus pa las zhi gnas skye/ snying po'i ar rlung sems 'dus pa las/ lhag mthong skye/ zung 'jug gi hūm̐ du rlung sems 'dus pa las/ zhi gnas dang lhag mthong zung ngu 'jug pa'i nyams snang skye'o/ /thun mong ma yin pa'i man ngag gi tshogs sbyor gnyis kyi mngon par rtogs pa/ bla ma chos kyi rgyal pos sbyar ba rdzogs so// //༄༅/ /rdo rje phur ba'i gtor chog bzhugs so/ /

༄༅/ /bcom ldan 'das rdo rje gzhon nu la phyag 'tshal lo/ /rdo rje phur pa'i gtor ma gtong bar 'dod pas rang rdo rje gzhon nur bsgom/ bzlas pa cung zad bya/ gtor ma bshams pa/ oṃ a mṛ tas bsang*/ swa bhā was sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las e las chos 'byung yangs pa'i nang du/ kaṃ las thod pa'i sgyed pu chen po'i steng du a las thod pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du/ shar du go las ba glang gi sha lhor ku las khyi'i sha nub tu da las rta'i sha byang du ha las glang po che'i sha dbus su na las mi'i sha de rnams kyi steng du/ shar du bi las dri chen/ dbus su mu las dri chu/ nub tu shu las byang sems/ byang du ma las klad pa/ lhor ra las rak+ta/ de rnams kyi steng du/ shar du bh+rūm̐ las me long lta bu'i ye shes/ lhor am̐ las mnyam pa nyid kyi ye shes/ nub tu dz+rīṃ las so sor rtog pa'i ye shes/ byang du kham̐ las bya ba grub pa'i ye shes/ dbus su hūm̐ las chos kyi dbyings kyi ye shes | de'i steng du nyi ma'i dkyil 'khor gyi steng du hūm̐ las rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ thod pa'i 'og tu yaṃ las rlung*/ de'i steng du raṃ las me/ rdo rje'i steng du khaṃ las chu bsam | de las chu'i phung po babs pas gtor ma'i nyes pa thams cad bkrus/ rlung gis me sbar bas sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga dang bcas pa zhu/ rlangs pa rdo rje la phog pas bdud rtsi'i rgyun babs/ de las 'od phyogs bcur 'phros pas/ 'khor 'das brtan g.yo'i bcud thams cad bsdus/ rdo rje dang bcas pa thod pa'i nang du lhung bas bdud rtsi'i rgya mtsho bsam gyis mi khyab par bsam/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ oṃ te dzo ba liṃ ta ba la ba te gu h+ye sid+dhi sa ma ya hūm̐ hri tha/ zhes pas kyang byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas mdun gyi nam mkhar rang gi gnas su sgom pa lta bu'i 'khor gyi lha rnams dang bcas pa'i rdo rje gzhon nu yab yum la/

sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' thams cad dang | srung ma thams cad kyis bskor ba spyan drangs la/ de la gtor ma phul bar bsam zhing*/ bla med mchog gi mchod pa dam pa 'di/ /ye shes lnga yi 'od zer rnam par 'phro/ /'dod pa'i yon tan lnga yis rab brgyan te/ /dam tshig bzhin du gus pas 'bul lags kyis/ /thugs dam thugs rjes ci bder bzhes nas kyang*/ /kī la ya yi dngos grub stsal du gsol/ /zhes brjod nas/ oṃ badz+ra kī li kī la ya dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ i daṃ/ dhu paṃ/ puṣ+paṃ/ dī paṃ/ gh+naghan+haṃ/ ba liṃ ta kha kha khā hi khā hi/ ma hā rak+ta khā hi/ ma hā tsita khā hi/ ma hā ba su ta khā hi/ sarba bi mā ra ya phaṭa/ ces pa gsum mam/ bdun gyis dbul/ hūm̐/ sgeg pa dpa' bo 'jigs su rung ba dang*/ /rgod dang gshe dang 'jigs par byed pa dang*/ /snying rje rngam dang zhi ba la sogs te/ /sku yi dngos po shin tu bsgyur ba ni/ /rgyan dang cha lugs ldan pas sgeg sgeg 'dra/ /bdud bzhi gdan du bting pas dpa' dpa' 'dra/ /sku che yan lag hrags (rags)pas 'jigs 'jigs 'dra/ /zhal g.yas dkar la bzhad pas rgod rgod 'dra/ /zhal g.yon dmar la gdangs pas gshe gshe 'dra/ /zhal dbus mthing la rngam pas khro khro 'dra/ /rgyud drug thugs rjes 'dzin pas brtse brtse 'dra/ /gdugs pa zhal du 'dren pas rngam rngam 'dra/ / chos sku mtshan ma med pas zhi zhi 'dra/ /rdo rje rtse dgus sa dgu'i rtog pa 'joms/ /rdo rje rtse lngas dug lnga dbyings su sgrol/ /me dpung 'bar bas 'khor ba'i nyon mongs bsreg kha ṭ+wāṃ rtse gsum dug gsum rtsad nas gcod/ /ri rab phur bus dgra bgegs gzir bar byed/ /de 'dra'i khro bo 'jigs pa'i skur ston pa | | rdo rje gzhon nu'i sku la phyag 'tshal lo/ /kī la ya yi dngos grub stsal du gsol | | zhes bstod cing gsol ba gdab bo/ /dge ba'i rtsa ba sangs rgyas su bsngo | oṃ badz+ra mus gtor ma'i mgron gshegs su gsol/

rang gi gnas gsum bsrungs la ci bder spyad do/ /rdo rje phur pa'i gtor ma/ sa skya pa'i phyag len 'phags pas slob dpon yul skyong gi don du yi ger bkod pa'o// //shubhaṃ//༄༅/ /seṅge'i mtha'i dris lan sogs 'phags pas mdzad pa 'ga' zhig bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhi/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo// gang gis kun mkhyen yon tan rgya mtsho yi/ /dpal yang bde blag nyid du stsol mdzad na/ /'dod rgu'i dpal gzhan smos kyang ci zhig 'tshal/ /de slad mtshungs med bla ma'i zhabs la 'dud/ /yang dag bla ma'i tshogs rnams gus bsten cing*// thos pa rgya mtsho'i nor gyis phyug gyur pa/ /seng ge'i mtha' yis ji ltar dris pa'i lan | | dge slong 'phags pas mdo tsam 'dir brjod bya/ /gang zhig theg pa gsum gyi nges 'byung la/ /theg pa gcig gi 'bras bu gnas pa'i tshul/ kho bo'i blo gros cung zad 'jug mod kyi/ /rgyas par brjod pa'i go skabs deng sang med// gal te slad nas go skabs rnyed gyur na/ /yi ger dgod pa'i rnam par bshad pa'am | | 'bel pa'i gtam gyis khyed sogs don gnyer ba'i/ /blo gsal rnams la nges par bgyid par spro/ /de la re zhig 'dir dris pa'i lan brjod par bya ste/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i dkyil 'khor chen por/ dbang bzhi yongs su rdzogs pa'i gang zag gcig la/ yan lag tshang ba'i ltung ba zhig byung na | bshags pa legs par byas la/ mtshan nyid ldan pa'i bla ma zhig la dbang yongs su rdzogs par blangs na sor chud cing rnam par dag par 'gyur ba lung rnams las 'byung zhing*/ mkhas pa rnams kyis zhal mthun par gsungs pa de lags | bdag 'jug byas pas 'dag par bshad pa dang*/ bla ma rnams kyis kyang 'dag par bshad pa'i dgongs pa yan lag ma tshang pa'i rtsa ltung dang*/ dam tshig gi nyes pa phra mo 'dug pa la dgongs/ yan lag tshang ba'i rtsa ba'i ltung ba byung ba de dam tshig nyams pa yin la/ nyams pa dang ma thob pa gnyis ka dam tshig med par mtshungs shing*/

dam tshig med par gsang sngags nyan pa tsam yang mi dbang na/ bdag nyid bskyed pa dang*/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa la dbang ba lta smos kyang ci mtshal/ bdag bskyed dang*/ dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa sngon du ma song ba'i bdag nyid 'jug pa ga la mchi/ 'o na rtsa ba'i ltung ba byung ba'i gang zag des | yul dus mtshungs par bla ma mtshan nyid dang ldan pa ma rnyed na/ ji ltar byed pa'i tshul ni/ thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba yang yang bya zhing*/ stobs bzhis sdig pa bshags pa yang yang byas pas/ sdig pa dag pa'i mtshan ma mthong ba dang | rten khyad par can la dmigs rten byas nas/ phyogs bcu'i de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad spyan drangs pa'i spyan sngar/ yi dam rang gis blang ba'i cho ga ltar/ smon dang 'jug pa'i sems bskyed yang yang blangs pas/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa sor chud par 'gyur/ sdig pa med na rten mtshungs pa med kyang phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas la sdom pa blang du rung ba 'jam dpal gyis sangs rgyas kyi zhing bkod pa las bshad/ theg pa chen po'i sdom pa thob pa des/ byang chub ltung bshags la sogs pa ltar theg pa chen po'i bshags pa yang yang byas pas/ sdig pa dag pa'i mtshan ma mthong ba dang*/ don zhags las 'byung ba ltar | gso sbyong rang gis blangs pa'i cho ga blangs nas/ gso sbyong dang smyung gnas bya zhing*/ de bzhin gshegs pa'i yi ge brgya pa la sogs pas sdig pa dang | dam tshig nyams pa sbyangs shing*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor las dbang len pa'i skal ba dang ldan par mdzad du gsol zhes yang yang gsol ba btab pas/ yi dam gyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i mtshan ma cung zad mthong bar 'gyur | 'jug pa sems bskyed pa thob nas/ bya spyod kyi rgyud kyi cho ga thun mong ba rnams nyams su blang du rung ba'i don/ dam tshig gsum bkod pa'i rgyal po las 'byung zhing*/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis kyang bzhed la/ sdom pa gsum gyi rab tu dbye ba las 'byung ba de lags/

de ltar yi dam gyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i mtshan ma rnyed pa des/ mchod pa rgya cher bshams nas/ mdun gyi yi dam gsal bar dmigs la spyi'i bshags pa dang*/ ltung ba'i ming dang*/ rigs nas smos pa'i bye brag gi bshags pa ste/ bshags pa gtso che ba'i bshags pa yang yang byas nas/ rigs lnga'i sdom pa gzung ba yang yang byas pas dam tshig dang sdom pa yang yang blang bar bya'o/ /'dis dam tshig dang ldan par 'gyur te/ yul gyis rjes su 'dzin pa'i mtshan ma rnyed pa'i yul dang ldan la/ sdig pa dag pa'i mtshan ma rnyed pa'i phyir/ las kyi sgrib pas kyang sgrib par mi 'gyur zhing*/ 'dun pa yod la brjod shes pa'i phyir/ cho ga'ang tshang bas ci nas kyang dam tshig dang ldan par 'gyur ba yin/ dbang dang ma 'brel bar dam tshig thob pa'i skabs srid dam snyam na/ dbang nyid kyi tshe'ang phyi 'jug gi dus su dam tshig thob la/ nang 'jug gi dkyil 'khor du zhugs shing dkyil 'khor mthong nas/ gzod dbang len pa nas/ dbang ma thob pa'i gong du dam tshig dang ldan par 'gyur ba yin/ 'jug pa dang dbang gnyis/ nub so sor byed pa dang dbang yang slob ma dang*/ slob dpon gyi dbang so sor bskur ba sngon gyi chen po 'ga' zhig gi phyag len la'ang yod par gda'/ des na dbang bskur ba'i nub mo ma yin par yang dam tshig thob pa'i skabs srid pa lags/ de ltar gong du bshad pa'i tshul gyis dam tshig thob pa des/ slar yang ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor las ting nge 'dzin gyi dbang blangs pas/ bskyed rim sgom pa'i skal ba dang ldan par 'gyur bas/ bskyed rim bsgom zhing bsnyen pa bskyal nas/ gzod phyi'i dkyil 'khor legs par bsgrubs nas/ bdag nyid 'jug pa dang dbang blang ba byas nas rnam par dag par 'gyur bar rtogs lags/ rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor ma bsgrubs pa'i gong du/ mdun gyi nam mkhar ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor dmigs pa las/ dbang len pa'i tshul 'di/

slob dpon kun dga' snying pos rdo rje 'byung ba las bshad | 'di'i lag len gnur pas byed pa la/ bla ma gong ma rnams kyis dgag pa mdzad de/ kun dga' snying po'i dgongs pa de rang du gda'/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor la dbang blangs pas/ nyes pa phra mo'ang rnam par dag nas/ gzod dkyil 'khor sgrub pa la dbang bar 'gyur bas | sngo ོna la dbang len pa'i rgyu mtshan der gda'/ des na phyi'i dkyil 'khor gyi gong du/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor las dbang len pa 'di/ kun dga' snying po'i rjes su 'brangs shing*/ rigs pas kyang 'thad par mthong ba lags/ rim pa 'di rnams/ gsum la skyabs 'gro nas brtsams te/ /byang chub sems sogs sdom pa ni/ /gal te bdag la phan 'dod na/ / snga gas pas 'bad de blang bar bya/ /zhes gsungs pas/ blang ba la/ bla ma la blang ba dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor la blang ba gnyis las/ phyi ma'i lag len ni de yin par go ba lags | de ltar sor chud pa'i gang zag de la/ snga ོ na dbang bka' mang po yod na dkyil 'khor gcig tu sor chud par byas nas/ gzod dbang bka'/ gang dang gang yod pa'i dkyil 'khor rnams bsgrubs shing bdag nyid zhugs te dbang blangs na/ snga ོna thob pa'i bag chags rgyud la yod pa dang*/ phyis bdag nyid kyis legs par blangs pa'i phyir/ sngar gyi dbang bka' rnams sor chud par 'gyur ba lags/ dgyes pa'i rdo rje'i g.yon gyi phyag mtshan gyi rim pa sa dang chu dang rlung dang ni/ me zhes gsungs pa'i phyi ma gnyis po lugs 'byung gi rim par ma gsungs pa'i rgyu mtshan/ g.yon gyi phyag mtshan brgyad kyis dbang phyug brgyad ster zhing dag la/ dbang phyug brgyad ni/ sgron gsal du rgyud kyi lung drangs pa las | sku yi dbang phyug gsung gi dbang phyug dang*/ /de bzhin du ni thugs kyi dbang phyug dang*/ /rdzu 'phrul kun tu 'gro ba'i dbang phyug dang*/ /ci 'dod phrin las yon tan brgyad pa'o/

/zhes gsungs pa las/ sku dang sa gzhan gyi rten byed par mtshon/ gsung dang chu gzhan 'dzin par mtshungs/ thugs dang me gsal bar mtshungs/ rdzu 'phrul dang rlung g.yo bar mtshungs/ kun 'gro dang zla ba'i 'od zer thams cad la 'jug par mtshungs/ ci 'dod dang nyi ma'i 'od zer gzhan smin par byed par mtshungs/ phrin las dang gshin rje mthu dang ldan par mtshungs | yon tan dang nor sbyin gzhan gyi dbul ba sel bar mtshungs pas rgyud nas bshad pa dbang phyug gi rim pa dang mthun par go bla ma kun gyis sa dang | chu dang*/ me dang*/ rlung gi rim par mdzad pa de/ 'byung ba lugs 'byung gi rim pa'i cha la dgongs par go phyag len la rgyud bzhin du mdzad pa lags/ de ltar khyed kyis dris la lan btab pa/ /'di la nongs gang bdag blo'i nyes par zad/ /'di yi legs chas 'gro ba bde bar shog/me pho stag gi lo rgyal gyi zla ba'i tshes gsum gyi nyin mo bris pa'o/ /dge'o// //༄༅/ /grags pa rin chen gyi dris lan no/ / ༄༅/ /oṃ swasti sid+dhaṃ/ dpal mgon bla ma'i zhabs la phyag 'tshal lo/ / sde snod 'dzin pa grags pa rin chen gyis/ /ji ltar dri ba byas pa de yi lan/ / mdo tsam bshad pa 'di la gus pas nyon/ /de la thog mar sdom pa gsum gyi ngo bo'am mtshan nyid ni/ ji srid 'tsho'i bar du gzhan la gnod pa gzhi dang bcas pa las ldog pa so so thar pa'i sdom pa/ byang chub gyi snying po'i bar du gzhan la gnod pa las ldog pa'i steng du sems can thams cad la phan pa bsgrub pa la zhugs pa'i sems pa rgyun chags pa can byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'o/ /bcu gsum rdo rje 'dzin pa'i go 'phang ma thob kyi bar 'bras bu sku gsung thugs rdo rje'i brtul zhugs la nye bar zhugs pa'i sems pa rgyun chags pa can rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa yin/ lung chos pa'i lugs kyis/ ngo bo dang mtshan nyid gcig tu 'dod pa lags/ gcig dang tha dad pa'i tshul ni/

nyan thos kyi so so thar pa'i sdom pa/ lus ngag la rnam par rig byed ma yin pa'i tshul gyis gnas par 'dod/ theg pa chen po'i lugs kyis sems la bag chags dge ba'i tshul gyis bgo bar 'dod pa yin pas/ grub mtha' so so'i rjes su 'brangs nas brtsi na tha dad du 'ong ba yin/ theg pa chen po'i lugs kyis gzhal na nyan thos kyi sdom pa nyid kyang*/ sems kyi khyad par gyi chos yin pas/ gnas pa'i tshe sems ngo bo gcig la bag chags kyis tha dad du phyed par 'dod/ de nyid dngos po'i gnas lugs su'ang go nyan thos dang theg chen gyi sdom pa gnyis po/ len pa'i tshe ci nas kyang tha dad/ byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ snga gas kyi sdom pa rim gyis pa'i lugs la/ so sor len/ so sor thob/ cig car du 'jug pa la cig car du thob pa'ang yod/ gtong ba'i tshe/ nyan thos kyi sdom pa gtong ba'i rgyu phal cher gyis byang chub sems dpa' dang*/ rig pa 'dzin pa'i sdom pa mi gtong*/ sdom pa gong ma gnyis gtong bas/ nyan thos kyi sdom pa mi gtong ba'i skabs kyang srid/ gsang sngags kyi sdom pa btang bas/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa mi gtong ba'i skabs kyang srid pa yin/ byang chub sems dpa'i sdom pa'i dngos gzhi btang bas/ gsang sngags kyi sdom pa mi gtong mi srid/ byang chub kyi sems las 'das nas sbyor dngos rjes gsum tshang bas rdo rje'i spun gsad pa lta bu la mthar thug grub pas gsum ka dus gcig la gtong ba yin/ mang po'i don du mi gcig gsad pa lta bus/ nyan thos kyi sdom pa gtong yang*/ sdom pa gong ma gnyis po mi gtong ba'i steng du/ dge ba yar ldan du 'ong ba yin/ rtsa sum cu rtsa gnyis kyi nang du sbas pa'i rtsa lnga mi 'du ba lags/ yan lag gi rlung lnga 'byung ba lnga'i ngo bo las mi 'da' ba'i phyir ngo bo'i cha nas rtsa ba'i rlung las gzhan ma yin

| gnas dang las kyi cha nas so sor bzhag pa yin/ dbang bskur ma thob pa la dril bu pa byed dus/ snga ོna du slob ma sbyong ba'i cho ga de/ dbang bskur rgyas pa'i sta gon gyi skabs kyi nang gi dbang bskur ba'i cho ga de lta bu byed pa lags/ thun mong ma yin pa'i gsang ba la bsre lhad bya ba'i gzhi rgyud mtshan nyid pa gcig yod pa'ang srid/ spyi rgyud kha 'thor ba'i lung mang po dang*/ mdo sde'i lung mang po bris 'dug pas thams cad bod kyis byas pa'ang ma yin/ mtshams sbyor ldan dang gaXcig tu mang po bzhugs 'dug de'i rgyu mtshan gyi gtso bo/ badz+ra dhṛka la sogs pa'i sngags kyi btu ba rnams rgya gar sbyor tshul rgyus med par/ bod kyi lugs su byas 'dug gzhan yang tshig gi sbyor ba btags pa mang po gda'/ spyir rgyud yang dag pa lhad med kyi bka' bstan bcos rnams la/ 'dris pa byas tsa na lhad can rnams mngon mtshan du rjen gcer 'ong rgyu zhig mche/ de ltar khyed kyis dris pa'i lan brjod pa'i/ /dge bas ma lus 'gro ba'i ma rtogs dang*/ / log rtog the tshom drwa ba rnams bsal nas/ /shes bya'i gnas la blo gros rgyas gyur cig /me mo yos bu'i lo/ smin drug zla ba'i nyi shu bdun gyi nyin par 'dam gyi sa'i cha gad skya zhes bya bar 'phags pas sbyar ba'o// //dge'o// //༄༅/ /dbang phyug 'bum gyi dris lan no/ / ༄༅/ /dris pa'i lan rnam par nges pa zhes bya ba/ bla ma dang 'jam pa'i dbyangs la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gang gi mkhyen brtse phul byung zhing*/ /mthu dang phrin las mtha' yas pas/ /rtag par gzhan gyi don mdzad pa'i/ /'gro ba'i bla ma la phyag 'tshal/ /blo gsal bla ma la gus pa'i/ /dbang phyug 'bum zhes bya ba yis// bsam pa dge bas dris pa'i lan/ /dri med lung bzhin 'dir bshad bya/ / thub pa byang chubaX sems dpaX' sangs rgyas pa'i/ /sa yi mtshams ni gang la bzhed/ / shākya thub pa sangs rgyas pa'i/ /dus ni bskal pa grangs med ston/

/'dir ni tshe lo brgya pa la/ / byang chub brnyes pa sprul pa yin/ / chos kyi phung po brgyad khri dang*/ /bzhi stong phung po'i tshad gang yin| | rjod byed rab byed 'dus pa yi/ /brjod bya'i rnam grangs mang ston pa'i/ / ngag rgyun gcig gis bsdus pa'i gzhung*/ /phung po nyid yin de yi tshad/ /gcig tu nges pa yod ma yin/ /spang bya nyon mongs gsum spong zhing*/ /brjod bya bslab pa gsum ston pa'i/ /rjod byed sde snod rnam pa gsum/ /so so ba dang spyir ston pa | | brgyan khri bzhi stong yod ces grags/ / sngags dang pha rol phyin pa yi/ /lam dang 'bras bu'i khyad par gang*/ / byang chub sems kyi gzhi brtan nas/ /stong nyid snying rje'i lam gyis ni/ /spangs rtog phun tshogs bcu gcig pa/ /sgrub pa pha rol phyin pa'i lugs | | smin byed dbang gis gzhi bzung nas/ /rim gnyis yan lag bcas pa yis/ /spangs rtogs bde chen bcu gsum pa/ /sgrub pa sngags kyi rnam gzhag yin | | bskal bzang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /sngags kyi theg pa gsungs lags sam/ / bskal bzang sangs rgyas thams cad kyis/ /gdul bya mchog la gsang sngags gsungs | | mtshan brjod dgongs pa de nyid yin/ /thun mong ba yi 'khor rnams la | | shākya thub pa kho nas gsungs/ /gsang 'dus dgongs pa 'di yin no/ / rgyud sde mi yi yul 'dir ni/ /dar lugs mdor bstan ji ltar lags/ / gdul bya'i skal ba'i dbang bzhin du/ / snga ོna tshe thub pas sprul pa yi/ /dkyil 'khor mngon par sprul mdzad nas/ /lha dang grub pa rig 'dzin dang*/ /mkha' 'gro sogs la gsang bar bshad/ /de dag rnams kyis skal ldan gyi/ /mi rnams la ni so so yi/ / ska la ba ji bzhin smin byas nas/ /rgyud dang man ngag so sor gsungs/ /de dag rnams las rab brgyud nas/ /mi yi yul du gsal bar gyur/ /'di yi dbye ba dpag med phyir/ /'di nyid do zhes sus brjod spobs/ /de lta mod kyi bla med tshul

| | phal cher nub phyogs u rgyan du/ /in+d+ra bhū tis gsal bar byas/ /rgyud sde 'og ma phal che ba/ /'phags pa'i yul gyi shar lho ru/ /rab gsal zla ba zhes bya ba/ /rgyal po mchog gis gsal bar byas/ /tse lu pa la sogs pa yis// sham+bha la la sogs pa ru/ /'phags pa rnams las thos pa'i tshul/ /kun tu gsal bar byas pa'ang yod/ / sems can dpag med grol gyur kyang*/ /'khor ba 'phel 'grib med pa ci/ / phri dang bsnan pa 'phel 'grib bcas/ /tshad ldan pa la 'thad pa ste/ / sems can grangs la tshad med phyir/ /grol bas nyung bar ga la 'gyur/ /srid pa bar do brdzus te skye/ /skye 'gyur las kyi gzhan dbang ste/ /de yi bag chags sngar sad phyir/ /gang du skye 'gyur byad gzugs can/ /gal te gang zag gzhan gyi mthus/ /skye ba yongs su bsgyur byed na/ /gang du bsgyur ba de gzugs su/ / de yang yongs su 'gyur ba can/ /dus ni phal cher zhag bdun no/ /bdun phrag bdun pa'ang yod ces grags/ /las kyi 'phen pa drag zhan gyis/ /mtshams med pa'ang 'byung 'gyur zhing*/ /lo dang bskal par gnas par bshad/ /de phyir gcig tu nges pa med/ / tshe 'di'i 'khri ba gcod pa'i thabs/ /nyams myong lag len ji ltar bde/ / sdug bsngal ba la sdug bsngal dang*/ /stong pa nyid la stong nyid dang*/ /bde ba la ni bde ba'i rgyur/ /shes na tshe 'di'i 'khri ba ci/ / bka' rgyud bla ma'i zhabs tog tu/ /tshul lugs ji ltar spyad na 'gyur/ / nus pa yod na chos bzhin du/ /gzhan don brtson pas bstan pa'i rgyun/ /gnas par byed pa bla ma dang*/ /rgyal ba mnyes byed dang po yin | | gzhan don sgrub pa'i mthu dman na/ /sgrub la brtson pas rang don la/ / gzhol ba mnyes byed gnyis pa ste/ /zang zing mchod pa gsum pa yin/ / dben par nyams len byed pa dang*/ /'chad nyan byed pa gang khyad 'phags/ / dang po sgro 'dogs gcod pa dang*/ /gzhan don bsgrub na nyan bshad bya/ /phyis nas rtogs pa bskyed pa dang

| | rang gi don la sgrub pa mchog khyod dang khyod 'dra gang yin pas/ /sgrub la nan tan bya bar rigs/ / bsam gtan bzlas sgom bya ba dang*/ /gzhung lugs bltas pa bogs gang che/ / dngos gzhi bsam gtan bzlas brjod brtson/ /skyo dang the tshom bsal ba dang*/ /dad dang nges shes bskyed pa'i phyir/ /bar skabs dag tu gzhung lugs blta/ / mdo sogs kha ton byed pa dang*/ /sngags kyi bzlas pa'i khyad par gang*// klog pa dang ni kha ton bas/ /bzlas brjod phan yon che bar gsungs/ / rtse gcig sgrub pa byed pa la/ /lam mchog bgrod tshul gang gis bde/ / dam tshig sdom pa'i gzhi brtan zhing | | bskyed pa'i rim pa mnyam gzhag nas/ /rjes thob bdag gzhan lhar rig pas/ /longs spyod pa yi mchod pas mchod/ / snga gas kyis rgyal ba'i thugs bskul zhing*/ /dge kun gzhan gyi don dmigs nas/ /smon lam bzang pos yongs bsgyur na/ /rgya chen sgrub pa'i rim pa ste/ /rang sems gdod nas rnam dag pa/ /bla ma'i thugs dang gnyis med par/ /shes na rtag tu mnyam 'jog pa// zab mo bsgrub pa'i rim pa yin/ /lus la gnad du bsnun pa'i thabs/ /shin tu zab mo yod mod kyi/ /sgrub par dka' zhing gegs mang phyir/ /re zhig mos pa tsam du bya/ / lam la 'bad par byed pa'i tshe/ /dge sbyor khrigs chags ji ltar bgyi/ / tho rangs rlung sems dwangs pa'i phyir/ /zab mo ting 'dzin bsgom par bya/ /langs nas khrus sogs sngon 'gro bas/ /yan lag bdun pas rgyud sbyangs nas/ /chos bzhin kha zas legs spyad de/ /nyin par kha ton bzlas brjod dang*/ /gtor ma chu sbyin la sogs pa/ /gtso bor lus ngag dge sbyor bya/ /srod la thub pas bdud btul phyir/ /srung ba'i 'khor lo brtan bsgoms nas/ /rim gnyis bzlas bcas sngon 'gro bas/ /mdun gyi ting 'dzin dkyil 'khor las/ /dbang bskur rin chen blang bar bya/ /nyal ba'i rnal 'byor dang 'brel ba'i/ /'chi kha ma yi gdams ngag ni/

/gnyid log tshe na bsgom bya zhing*/ /'dun pa sngon du 'gro ba yis/ /rmi lam na'ang chos rnams kun/ /rmi lam nyid du shes bya zhing*/ / de yang lha dang bla ma dang*/ /bdag nyid rjes su dran par bya/ /sad pa'i tshe na 'od gsal las//zung 'jug chen por ldang bar bya/ /dus rnams kun tu bla ma dang*// 'bral med lam gyi snying po yin/ /nyams su blang ba'i rim pa 'dis/ /rnal 'byor dus kun 'da' bar bya/ / bskyed rim rnam rtog yin pas na/ /'ching 'gyur bya ba ji ltar lags| | bskyed rim rtog pa yin mod kyi/ khye'us khye'u 'byin pa bzhin/ /rtog pas rtog pa sel ba'i phyir/ /grol ba'i thabs kyi mchog yin no/ / rig pa'i dbang lnga dbang rdzas la/ /mtshon bya so so ji ltar sbyor/ / rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba'i rjes/ /ye shes lnga yi mtshon byed yin/ /'di yi rgyu mtshan mang yod kyi/ /mdor bsdus de tsam shes par gyis/ / rgyal ba rigs lngar gsungs pa ni/ /longs sku'am sprul sku gang du bzhed// ye shes lnga ni mtshon pa'i phyir/ /rigs lnga mchog ni sprul pa ste/ /gdul bya mchog gi ngo bor snang*/ /longs skur bshad pa mchog la dgongs*/ / rigs lnga chos gos gtsug tor can/ /'di 'dra gsungs pa bdog lags sam/ / rigs lnga dge sbyong cha lugs su | | dam pa'i gsung las 'byung ba mthong*/ /lung las bshad pa ngas ma mthong | | 'on kyang de nyid bsdus pa las/ /sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' rnams/ /ji ltar dga' ba'i sku dang ni/ /cha lugs can zhes gsungs pa'i phyir/ /dge sbyong tshul la'ang 'gal ba med/ / dam pa rigs brgya'i rnam dbye ni/ / mdor sdus dbye lugs gang gis byed/ / sangs rgyas rigs lnga re re yang*/ /ye shes lnga lnga'i bdag nyid can/ /ye shes re re gzhan don gyis/ /dbye na tshad med bzhi bzhi po/ /de phyir de dag rigs rnams brgya/ /'di ni 'bras bu'i dbye ba ste/ /rgyu dang lam yang 'dis dpyad bya/

/zhi ba'i lha ni bzhi bcu gnyis/ khro bo lnga bcu rtsa brgyad la/ /dam pa rigs brgya yin no zhes/ /rnying ma ba rnams smras mod kyi/ / 'phags pa'i yul nas byung ba yi/ /rgyud sde rnams la de ma grags/ / rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul gcig nyid la/ /lha rnams dngos grub nye ring ci/ / rgyal ba'i rnam 'phrul gcig nyid la// rnam pa'i rten cing 'brel 'byung dang*/ /sgrub po'i las kyi dngos grub la/ /nye ring 'byung zhing de yang ni/ /thun mong lha la sgrol ma dang*/ /thun mong min la bde ba'i mchog /shin tu bsgrub thag nye'o zhes/ /bla ma mchog gi gsung las byung*/ / sgrol ma lta bu'i sgom bzlas dang*/ /bde dgyes dngos grub khyad par ci/ / sgrol ma la sogs thun mong gi /dngos grub sgrub pa'i lha ru gsungs/ /dges rdor bde mchog la sogs pa | | mchog gi go 'phang thob byed yin/ / phyag mtshan brgyad ni dbang phyug brgyad/ /de brgyad ngos 'dzin ji ltar lags/ / dbang phyug brgyad ni zla grags kyis/ /rnam gzhag gzhan du bshad mod kyi/ /phyag mtshan brgyad kyi dag pa ni/ /mi thub zla ba'i zhal snga nas/ /sa ni dang po nor sbyin mtha'/ /zhes gsungs don ni 'byung bzhi dang | | nyi zla tshe dang nor rnams la/ /dbang bsgyur brgyad ni dbang phyug go / bdag gnas rnal 'byor gsum gsungs pa'i/ /bdag dang rnal 'byor khyad par gang*/ / bdag gnas rnal 'byor gsum gsungs pa/ /bdag ni sgrub po nyid yin te/ /rnal 'byor ting 'dzin nyid du 'dod/ /ting 'dzin bskyed pa'i gegs bsal phyir/ /rnal 'byor bsrung bar gsungs pa yin/ /gnas ni gang du bsgrub pa'i yul/ / lha yi dmigs pa mi gsal na/ /thabs tshul gang gis gsal ba yin/ / lha yi dmigs pa gsal ba'i thabs/ / spyan sogs sku yi cha shas la/ /goms par byas nas slob pa dang*/ /bris pa la sogs me long la/ /shar ba'i gzugs brnyan la dmigs te/ /de dang 'dra bar sgom pa yin/ /rim gyis dmigs pa gsal bar 'gyur/

/rgyas par gzhan las shes par gyis/ / dben par skyo ba skye pa na/ /tshul lugs ji ltar spyad par bgyi/ / snying rje bde ba sgom pa dang*/ kha na ma tho med pa yi/ /'dod pa'i yon tan spyod pa dang*/ / chos kyi gtam dang mdo sogs la/ /blta bas skyo ba bsal bar bya/ /ji ltar 'os pa'ang rang gis dpyad/ / nad dang zug rngus nyen pa la/ /gnyen po nyams len ji ltar yin// nad dang zug rngu glo bur gyi/ /nyon mongs rnams kyi gnyen por ni/ /stong nyid ting 'dzin mchog yin zhes/ /lhag bsam bstan pa'i mdo las gsungs/ / 'chi bas 'jigs pa'i rtags byung na/ /nyams len tshul lugs gang gis bde/ / rang lus lha yi grong khyer nas/ /bla ma rigs kyi bdag po yi/ /sku yi gzhal yas yid 'ong bar/ / sny-ing po chu skyes gdan steng du/ / glo ga gi tshul gyis rab 'jug cing*/ /dbyings las ye shes ji bzhin du/ / ska ra mda'i tshul gyis 'dres gyur nas/ /mi rtog ngang la mnyam 'jog pa/ /dus rnams kun tu bsgom par bya/ /goms nas nying mtshams sbyor tshe tsaXm/ /'di yi ༷shes pa 'chi ba dang*/ /gshin rje'i 'jigs pa gyi na yin/ / theg pa dman la zhugs pa yis/ /sangs rgyas gegs su rtag 'gyur ram/ / theg pa che las blo log nas/ /theg dman kho nar zhugs gyur na/ /ji srid de las ma log pa | | de srid de yi gegs su 'gyur/ /mthar thug 'phags pa gnyis ka yang*/ / sangs rgyas nyid du 'gyur ro zhes/ /dam chos pad+ma dkar la sogs/ /nges pa'i don gyi mdo las 'byung*/ /so so thar pa'i sdom pa sogs/ /theg chen lam gyi yan lag tu/ /byed na de yi grogs su 'gyur/ /phal cher kun slong dbang yin no | | dmigs med snying rje chen po de/ /dus tshod gang la skye bar 'gyur/ / dmigs med snying rje mtshan nyid pa/ /rab dga'i sa la skye bar bshad/ /cha mthun da lta 'byung ba'ang srid | | mthar phyin sangs rgyas 'ba' zhig lags/ / rgyal ba'i sku gsum rnam gzhag ji ltar bsdu/

/dmigs med snying rje ji ltar bzhed pa lags/ / chos sku rgyal ba'i rang bzhin te/ / longs sku tshogs gnyis rdzogs pa'i 'bras/ /sprul sku de yi rnam 'phrul yin/ / mi 'dra'i rnam gzhag bshad pa mang*/ /tshul khrims byang sems dam tshig gsum// gzhi yin phyir na brtan par bya/ /dad dang snying rje smon pa gsum/ / sngo na 'gro yin phyir sngon du ྄bsgom/ /lha dang bla ma rang rigs gsum/ /dngos gzhi yin phyir mnyam par bzhag /bsngo ba smon lam rjes dran gsum/ /mjug sdud yin phyir mjug tu bya/ /sgyu ma stong nyid zung 'jug gsum/ khyab byed yin phyir kun rgyas gdab/ /gsum tshan lnga ru spel ba yi/ /chos tshul bcu dang lnga phrag gcig /rjes su slob pa'i gang zag la/ /nor gyi snying po byin pa yin/ /de ltar khyed kyis gang la dris pa'i lan/ /dri med lung gi tshul bzhin bshad pa yi/ /dge ba gang des 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /chos kyi rgyal po'i go 'phang thob par shog /'dan gyi yul du skyes pa'i blo gsal ba'i dge sbyong dbang phyug 'bum zhes bya bas dris pa la

| 'phags pas lan du btab pa'i rab tu byed pa shing pho byi ba'i lo/ ston zla ra ba'i tshes nyi shu gcig la mtshal mdor sbyar ba'i yi ge pa ni a tsa ra'o/ / 'dir gsang sngags kyi tshul gtso cher 'byung bas/ dbang ma thob pa la bstan par mi bya'o/ /rtag chad 'khyog po'i lam la mi gzigs shing*/ /'chad rtsod rtsom pa'i khur gyis ngal ba spangs/ /mi shes 'dam bu'i tshal rnams rlag byed pa'i/ / rnam dpyod gnyis 'thung dbang po'i bzhon pa de/ /'di bris dge las 'gro la myur thob shog /dge'o// //༄༅/ /gtor ma'i de nyid brgyad pa bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dam pa rnams la phyag 'tshal lo/ /gtor ma'i de nyid bstan par bya/ gtor ma ni sde snod gsum dang*/ rgyud sde bzhi nas gsungs pa yin te/ 'dul ba nas gtsang sbra legs par bya ba dang*/ bden pa bdar ba dang | chos bshad gsung*/ mdo sde nas sngags dang phyag rgya kho nas 'bul bar gsungs/ mngon pa nas mgron gyi bye brag dang*/ bya thabs rnams gsungs te/ de yang kha 'bar ma'i gzungs sngags la sogs pa mdo sde mang po nas gsungs/ rgyud sde bzhi nas sngags dang phyag rgyas gtor ma 'bul ba ma gsungs pa med de/ kye rdo rje dang*/ bde mchog dang*/ gsang 'dus dang*/ rnal 'byor bla na med pa'i rgyud nas sngags gsungs pa dang*/ rnal 'byor gyi rgyud dang*/ bya ba'i rgyud dang*/ spyod pa'i rgyud dang*/ phyag na rdo rje dbang bskur ba'i rgyud dang*/ rnam par snang mdzad mngon par byang chub pa'i rgyud sid+dhi kā ra legs par grub pa'i rgyud dang*/ kri ya dpung bzang gi rgyud dang*/ rig pa mchog gi rgyud dang*/ gnod sbyin gar mkhan gyi rgyud dang*/ de rnams nas phyag rgya kho nas 'bul bar bstan pa dang*/ mdo rgyud la la nas ting nge 'dzin gyis 'bul ba gtso bor bstan te/ de ltar bka' nas legs par gsungs pa dang*/ de nas bka'i dgongs pa bsdus pa dang | bka'i dgongs pa 'grel ba dang*/

bka'i don bshad pa dang*/ bka' nyams su len pa'i lag len ston pa/ byang chub sems dpa' spyan ras gzigs dbang phyug dang*/ 'jam dbyangs dang*/ phyag na rdo rje la sogs pa byang chub sems dpa' chen po rnams kyis mdzad pa dang*/ de'i rjes su zhugs pa grub thob sa ra ha dang*/ slob dpon klu sgrub dang*/ slob dpon dzā ya se nas legs par bstan no/ /de ltar sgrub pa po rnams kyis chos spyod kyi lag len ni gtor ma yin te/ gtor ma 'di slob dpon pad+ma la sogs pa grub thob rnams kyis mang po bshad kyang*/ don brgyad du bsdus nas bstan te/ ༈ dang po gtor ma'i phan yon bstan pa dang*/ rgyu mtshan bstan pa dang*/ mgron bstan pa dang*/ gtor ma'i dbye ba bstan pa dang*/ nyams su len mkhan gyi gang zag bstan pa dang | gtor ma'i rdzas bstan pa dang*/ byin gyis brlab pa bstan pa dang*/ dam tshig bstan pa dang brgyad do// ༈ dang po gtor ma'i phan yon bstan pa ni/ gtor ma 'di la pha rol tu phyin pa drug tshang ba dang*/ bsdu dngos bzhi tshang ba dang | sdom pa gsum tshang ba dang*/ bar chad thams cad sel ba dang*/ phrin las thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba dang*/ phrin las myur du sgrub pa dang*/ phrin las thams cad ma tshang ba kha skong ba dang*/ tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs shing bla na med pa'i byang chub thob pa'i phan yon dang brgyad do/ /de la pha rol tu phyin pa drug tshang ba ni/ dngos po gtong bas sbyin pa/ sems can la 'tshe ba med cing gtsang sbra dang ldan pas tshul khrims/ dka' ba dang du len pas bzod pa/ gtong bas brtson 'grus/ gtong ba'i dus ting nge 'dzin ma yengs pas bsam gtan | cho ga nor ba med cing 'khor gsum yongs su dag pas shes rab bo/ / de ni pha rol tu phyin pa drug tshang ba'o/ /gnyis pa bsdu dngos bzhi tshang ba ni/ gtor ma mgron rnams la bsngos pas sbyin pa/ mgron so so la bstod pa de ngag snyan pa/ 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba 'debs pa de don spyod pa/

'khor gsum yongs su dag pas bsngo ba de don mthun pa'o/ /gsum pa sdom pa gsum tshang ba ni | gtor ma'i dus su gtsang sbra dang ldan pa dang*/ sems can la gnod pa'i mi dge ba med pas so sor thar pa'i sdom pa dang*/ gzhan don du gtong bas byas chub sems dpa'i sdom pa dang*/ lha sgom sngags kyi sdom pa ste sdom pa gsum tshang ba'o/ /bzhi pa bar chad sel ba ni/ gtor mas bdud bzhi'i bar chad sel te/ gtong ba'i dus su sems bskyed la sogs pa'i bsam pa des nyon mongs pa'i bdud bcom/ na tsha dang duḥkha sel nus pas phung po'i bdud bcom | bgegs rigs stong phrag brgyad cu'i gnod pa srung bas lha'i bu'i bdud bcom/ tshe srog spel bar nus pas 'chi bdag gi bdud bcom/ de'i lo rgyus kyang*/ tshe dang ldan pa kun dga' bos/ bas mtha' zhig tu phyin pas/ yi dwags kha nas me 'bar ba zhig dang 'phrad nas/ khyod da nas zhag bdun na 'chi bas nga'i zas skal yin zer bas/ kun dga' bo shin tu bred pas/ bcom ldan 'das la zhus pas bcom ldan 'das kyis gzungs sngags gzi brjid tshad med pa'i gtor ma gnang nas/ gtor ma btang bas 'chi ba'i 'jigs pa las bzlog pa lta bu'o/ /lnga pa phrin las thams cad kyi sngon du 'gro ba ni/ zhi ba'i phrin las la nad gdon zhi ba la gtor ma dgos pa dang*/ rgyas pa'i phrin las la tshe dang longs spyod rgyas pa la gtor ma dgos pa dang*/ drag po'i phrin las la dgra bgegs gang sgrol yang gtor ma dgos so/ /drug pa gtor mas lha mnyes nas phrin las myur du 'grub/ gtor ma ma chag par btang na/ mi ma yin phra mo rnams kyis dngos grub sna re ster ba yin/ rnal 'byor pa ka da ri pa bya bas/ gtor ma gtong ba'i dus su mi ma yin phra mo mang po glu len rtsed mo byed kyin yong skad/ phyi res zhig khong rnams ngu yin byung skad/ khyed rnams ci nyes byas pas | khyod zhag bdun nas 'chi bar 'dug pas nged rnams la gtor ma ster mi med zer skad/

rnal 'byor pas 'o na khyod rnams la 'chi ba zlog pa'i thabs med dam byas pas/ thabs yod kyis bdog pa thams cad thong zhig zer ro/ / nged rnams kyis phyi'i rgya mtsho'i 'gram nas sman chen po zhes bya ba'i dngul chu yod kyi nged kyis de blang gis khyed kyis de la bcud len gyis shig tshe 'phel bar 'gyur ro zhes zer bas/ rnal 'byor pas rdzas kyi dngos po yod tshad btang | gtor ma la brtson par byas shing sman chen po'i bcud len byas pas tshe 'phel te/ lo lnga brgya 'phel bar gyur to/ /bdun pa phrin las thams cad kyi ma tshang ba kha bskang bar 'gyur ba ni/ slob dpon pad+ma'i zhal nas gzungs sngags gzi brjid tshad med pa 'di lan bdun brjod na/ cho ga ma tshang ba thams cad kha bskang ba yin/ sngags pas mdos btang ba'i dus su lan bdun brjod na cho ga ma tshang ba kha skong bar 'gyur ba yin gsung skad/ bskang gso thams cad gtor ma la brten nas byed dgos so/ /brgyad pa tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs pa ni/ gtor ma'i zhing rnam par dag pa bla ma dang dkon mchog dngos po rnam par dag pa/ mchod pa'i sprin phung bsdus zhing phul bas/ bsod nams kyi tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs shing thugs rjes skyob par 'gyur pa'i phan yon yod do | | yon tan gyi mgron la phul bas phan pa rgya chen po 'grub cing gnod pa thams cad zlog pa'i phan yon yod do/ /snying rje'i mgron la bsngos pas gzhan don 'grub cing theg pa chen por 'gyur ba dang longs spyod 'phel ba'i phan yon yod do/ /lan chags kyi mgron la phan pa rgya chen pos bsngos pas/ snga ma'i sha 'khon byang ba dang*/ phyi mar gnod pa mi byed pa'i phan yon yod do/ /zhing dman pa yi dwags la bsngos pas tshogs che ba ni/ slob dpon dze tā ri dgra las rnam par rgyal bas/ yi dwags kyi gling du phyin tsa na/ yi dwags mo shin tu rid pa zhig dang 'phrad skad/ mo na re lo dgu'i bar du chu ma myong*/

nga'i khyo zhig yod pa de 'di nas shar phyogs kyi gling du chu tshol du song yod pas/ khyod der 'gro na chu myur du khyer la shog gyis skad/ de ngas ngo mi shes byas pas/ sha rtsa ser ba/ lag na shog bu thogs pa zhig yod zer skad/ de nas slob dpon gyis der byon nas de la khyod kyi bu smad la chu ma bskyal na 'chi bar 'dug go byas pas/ nga rang gi 'thung rgyu yang ma rnyed/ dge tshul zhig gis lud pa bor ba de thob sha byas pas | ngas phyed las ma thob ste/ shog bur blugs pas skam nas 'dug lo bdun chu de las ma rnyed zer skad/ der slob dpon gyis gtor ma dang chu sbyin dpag tu med pa btang */ yi dwags thams cad tshim par byas pas/ kho yang ngoms par byas/ kho'i shog bu yang gang bar byas nas bskur btang*/ yi dwags la chu sbyin pa bas bsod nams che ba med gsung skad/ de ltar bsod nams kyi tshogs so/ /ye shes kyi tshogs ni 'khor gsum yongs su dag pa ste/ gzung 'dzin gnyis kyis stong par shes pa'o/ /de ltar gtor mas tshogs gnyis myur du rdzogs nas bla na med pa'i byang chub 'thob par 'gyur ro/ ༈ /gnyis pa gtor ma'i rgyu mtshan bstan pa ni/ gtor zhes bya ba ma chags zhing chags pa med pas btang ba'o/ /ma zhes bya ba ni mi sdang zhing sdang ba med par kun la snyoms par btang ba'o/ /yang na gtor zhes bya ba kun la khyab/ /'dzin chags med pas ma zhes bya// ༈gsum pa mgron bstan pa ni/ dkon mchog srid zhu'i mgron dang*/ mgon po yon tan gyi mgron dang*/ rigs drug snying rje'i mgron dang | sha 'khon lan chags kyi mgron dang bzhi'o/ /mgron de rnams spyan drangs na ni 'byon/ spyan ma drangs na mi 'byon pa'i mgron gang yin snyam na/ srid zhi'i mgron dang*/ yon tan gyi mgron gnyis ni/ spyan ma drangs na mi 'byon/ spyan drangs na thugs rje dang smon lam gyi stobs kyis mos pa dang gus pa yod pa'i sar cis kyang 'byon pa yin no/

/spyan drangs kyang mi 'ong ba'i mgron ni/ rigs drug gi khongs na yod de*/ gnod sbyin byang chub 'dzin lag na gzhong thogs/ gnod sbyin lag ring*/ ri rtse bkan/ rtag myos rnams ni spyan drangs kyang 'ong ba'i skabs med de/ lag na gzhong thogs ni ri rab kyi bang rim dang*/ rgya mtsho'i chu yi bar mtshams na yod pas/ pho brang chus khyer gyis dwogs nas rgyun mi chad par gzhong pas chu gsho dgos pas kho la 'ong ba'i skabs med do/ /lag ring ni dbus kyi ri bo mchog rab la 'khyud nas/ kho ri bo mchog rab 'gyel gyis dwogs nas 'ong ba'i skabs med do/ /ri rtse bkan ni ri bo mchog rab kyi rtse nas gling bzhi'i sems can rnams la dgra byung gis dwogs nas bya ra byed dgos pas 'ong ba'i skabs med do/ /rtag myos ni 'dod pa'i yon tan lngas rgyun chad med par myos pas kho 'ong ba'i skabs med do/ /de rnams spyan drangs kyang mi 'ong ba'i mgron bzhi yin no/ /spyan drang du mi rung ba'i mgron bzhi ni/ sa bdag stobs po che/ yi dwags gter srung*/ sa bdag shrī bat+tā/ klu ho pan rnams spyan drang du mi btub ste/ sa bdag stobs po che ni spyan drangs na/ ri bo mchog rab gyi 'og na yod pas/ rlung rdo rje rgya gram g.yos nas sems can gyi gnas su sa g.yo dang*/ 'khrugs pa dang*/ mi dge ba sna tshogs yong bas kho spyan drang du mi btub | yi dwags gter srung spyan drangs na/ gter gyi bum pa gzhan gyis khyer nas 'jig rten du mu ge yong bas kho spyan drang du mi btub/ sa bdag shrī bat+tā'i lag na nad kyi rkyal pa yod pas kho spyan drangs na nad kyi rkyal pa kha shor nas 'jig rten du mi nad phyugs nad yong bas spyan drang du mi btub/ klu ho pan la mthong ba'i dug yod pas/ kho 'ong na klu'i nad sna tshogs 'ong bas/ kho spyan drang du mi btub bo/ /spyan drang du mi btub pa'i mgron bzhi'o/

/spyan ma drangs kyang 'ong ba'i mgron bzhiX ni/ yi dwags mkha' la rgyu ba'i rigs dang*/ dri za'i rigs rnams ni/ gtor ma bshams pa tsam gyis 'ong ste/ dper na sbrang ma rtsi la 'khor ba'am | ston mo'i dus su sprang po 'du ba dang 'dra'oX// //༈ bzhi pa gtor ma'i dbye ba bstan pa ni/ phyi gtor/ nang gtor/ gsang gtor/ de kho na nyid/ chen po'i gtor ma dang lnga'o/ /phyi gtor dkar gsum mngar gsum byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ mgron gang la yang phul bas choganang gtor 'dod yon du byin gyis brlabs pa ni rigs drug la bsngags so/ / gsang gtor sha lnga bdud rtsi lngar byin gyis brlabs pa ni/ mkha' 'gro chos skyong la shis so/ /de kho na nyid chen po'i tshogs ni/ gnod byed lan chags kun la shis so/ /gtor ma chen po ni/ phyi snod kyi 'jig rten gtor snod/ nang bcud kyi sems can gtor ma'i rang bzhin te/ snang srid thams cad gtor mar ma gyur pa gang yang med de/ mi gtong ba'i dngos po rtswa'i rtse mo tsam yang med do/ /bdag 'dzin thams cad dang bral ba'o// //༈ lnga pa gtor ma'i gang zag gi mtshan nyid bstan pa ni/ dbang po rab rtogs pa dang ldan pa'i rten gyi gang zag gis gtor ma gcig las med kyang*/ mgron thams cad kyi snang ba la so sor gang 'dod kyi dbang po dang 'tshams pa'i longs spyod du 'byung ste/ rin po che'i phung po las dgos 'dod sna tshogs 'byung ba bzhin no/ /dbang po 'bring gis cho ga nor 'khrul med pa'i sngags dang phyag rgya dang*/ ting nge 'dzin gyi byin gyis brlabs kyis bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor bsgyur nus so/ /dbang po tha mas bsngos pas gtor ma gang bshams pa de thob bo// //༈ drug pa gtor ma'i rdzas bstan pa la gtor ma'i snod dang*/ gtor ma'i rgyu dang*/ gtor ma'i bsham thabs dang gsum mo/ /dang po nang gtor la ka pā la shis so/ /phyi gtor la ka pā li dang*/ ting ma yin pa/ lcags phor dang lcags gzer med pa/

gas chag med pa'i snod la bya'o/ /ka pā li la yi dwags phra mo rnams 'jigs pa dang*/ ting la lha ma yin gyi thoXd pa dang mthun pas so/ / lcags ni drag po'i rdzas mtshon bya ( cha ) 'i rgyu yin pas yi dwags rnams 'jigs pa'o | | gnyis pa gtor ma'i rgyu ni/ nang gtor la sha lnga/ bdud rtsi lnga'am sha chang la sogs pa bzang po la bya'o/ /tha ma dug dang mtshon spang ba'i gang rnyed la bya'o | | phyi gtor la sha chang sgog tsong spangs pa/ dkar gsum la sogs pa 'dzoms na bzang*/ tha ma sna rer brten pas chog gtor ma'i zan la sla mo mi bya | rang za nyan pa tsam bya/ gtor ma la mtheb kyu mi bya/ jo bo'i zhal nas bod la phyug po mi yong*/ gtor zan sla mo byed/ gtor ma la mtheb kyu byed par 'dug gsung skad/ gtor zan la dri mas ma gos par bya/ dri ma can la chos skyong mi 'khor/ rang la 'go ba'i nad dang*/ ting nge 'dzin mi gsal/ dri ma can ni kun la mi btub bo/ /gsum pa gtor ma'i bsham thabs ni/ stegs med la mi bsham/ mthong sar bsham/ mi mthong sar mi bsham/ drang por bsham/ yon por mi bsham/ phyis bcos na bar chad kyi rgyu yin/ rtsar snod stong mi bzhagade la yang re ba yin// //༈ bdun pa byin gyis brlab pa ni/ bsham ma thag tu byin gyis brlabs pas bar chad mi 'byung ba yin/ tshad med pa bzhi bsgoms pas gzhan la phan pa rgya chen po 'byung ba yin/ skyabs su 'gro ba byas pas bden pa'i byin rlabs 'byung ba yin/ phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas spyan drangs nas/ bdun rnam dag byas pas tshogs rgya chen po rdzogs pa yin/ yi dam gyi lha bsgoms pas gtor ma byin gyis rlabs pa yin/ dag pa gsum gyi sngags brjod pas bdag 'dzin gyi dri ma dag pa yin/ yi ge gsum brjod pas dngos po bdud rtsir 'gyur ba yin zhing*/ 'dod yon zag med du 'gyur ba yin/ gzungs sngags brjod pa'i yon tan gyis bdud rtsir 'gyur ba dang*/ mang po dpag tu med par spel ba dang*/

dgos 'dod thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ gang 'dod thams cad 'byung ba dang*/ gang 'dod des thob pa dang*/ ngoms shing tshim par 'gyur ba'i yon tan yod pas lan mang du brjod par bya'o/ /de bzhin gshegs pa'i mtshan brjod pa'i yon tan ni/ dang po gnyis kyis gtor ma byin gyis rlob/ phyi ma gnyis kyis mgron byin gyis rlob pa'i yon tan dang*/ mchod sbyin phyag rgyas byin gyis rlob pa'i yon tan no/ /spyan 'dren pa'i phyag rgya ni/ 'bar ba'i phyag rgya'am/ lcags kyu'i phyag rgyas 'dren pa'i yon tan no/ /se gol gyi phyag rgyas bzhes par 'gyur ba'i yon tan no/ /so so'i gnas su skyel ba ye shes skar mda'i phyag rgya'o/ /ting nge 'dzin rtse gcig pas don thams cad 'grub pa'i yon tan no/ /gzhan yang mgron gyi bye brag gis/ la las bsham pa tsam gyis thob pa yod/ la las sngags brjod pas thob pa yod/ la las ting nge 'dzin gyis thob pa yod/ gtor ma bshams nas ma bsngos pa'i bar der mi ma yin gyis 'khyer ba'ang yod de/ bla ma rdo rje gdan pas gtor ma bcas nas bsngo ba la sogs pa ma byung nas/ en tsam lon nas bsngos pas mgron mngon sum du byung nas/ khyod kyis nga la ster 'dod kyi gtor ma de gzhan gyis zos zin zer skad/ gtor ma bshams nas 'jog pa'i tshe/ srung ba'i 'khor lo bsgoms la bzhag go /gtor ma bcos nas ma bsngos pa'i bar der/ kyal ka'i ched du gzhan la bsngos na yang mgron des mi thob ste/ de'i rgyu mtshan yang sngon klong thang sgrol ma'i chos skyong rdo rje khol mo yin pas mchod pa byed pa'i dus shig kho la bshos bu bzang po bshams nas ma bsngos pa'i bar der/ byis pas kyal ka'i ched du/ dpal mgon po mchod byas pas

| de nas kho la bsngos pas/ de'i nub mo gnyer pa'i rmi lam du byung nas/ nga la bshos bu mi ster ba ci yin zer skad/ khyod la bshos bu bzang po byin pa byas pas/ de byis pas dpal mgon po nag po la phul/ de ngas mig gis kyang blta mi nus zer skad do/ /de yang gtor ma gtong ba'i dus su myur du gtong ba gal che'o/ /mgron la la ni phud kho na za la lhag ma mi 'dod pa'o/ /la la ni lhag ma kho na za la/ phud mi thob pa yang yod pas thams cad phyogs gcig tu bsngos nas btang ba bas/ cha mang du byas nas so so gang 'dod kyi gnas su bsngos na bsod nams che bar 'dug gsung ngo*/ /bden pa bdar zhing chos bshad pas phan pa sgrub cing gnod pa mi skyel ba'i phan yon yod do/ /gtor ma ma chag par gtong ngo*/ /chag na nyes pa che ste/ dpal nā ro pas lan cig gi lhag gtor brjed pas rmi lam na/ nged rnams kyi skal ba bcad zer nas ngu ba mang po byung ngo gsung skad do/ /gtor ma sa gtsang sar stegs mtho ba'i khar btang ngo*/ khyis zos na khyi la mche ba'i dug yod de/ gcan gzan gyi rigs yin pas so/ /'byung po gtor khung nas za ba rnams kyis mi thob/ rnal 'byor pa la 'go ba'i nad ldang*/ rigs rgyud sogs la ngan/ rnal 'byor pas zhi ba'i gtor ma zor du mi 'phen/ 'phangs na srog la gnod/ rgyas pa dang dbang gi gtor ma thag ring du mi bskyal/ bskyal na dngos grub gzhan du 'pho/ lam zhugs bar chad sel ba'i gtor ma 'gro phyogs su gtong*/ phyogs log na phyi dal kyi rgyu yin/ 'chi bslu lan chags gyi gtor ma phyogs bcur gtor ro/ / drag po gegs sel gyi gtor ma rgyang bsring ngo*/ /rtsar bzhag na 'khor la gnod/ drag po dgra bgegs sgrol ba'i gtor ma zor du brdeg go/ //༈ brgyad pa gtor ma'i dam tshig drug nyams len gyi dam tshig ma chag pa | snod kyi dam tshig gas chag med cing gtsang sbra ldan pa/ rgyu'i dam tshig 'bags btsog med cing dri mas ma gos pa/

bsham pa'i dam tshig stegs bu dang ldan zhing ma yo ba/ byin gyis rlabs pa'i dam tshig mi 'gal zhing ma yengs pa/ btang ba'i dam tshig gtsang bar ( sar ) bskyal zhing gtor snod bshal ba'o/ / gtor ma'i de nyid don brgyad pa/ sa skya paṇ+ḍi ta'i zhabs rdul spyi bos len pa/ btsun pa 'phags pas shing mo lug gi lo la/ rgyal po chen pos bskul nas pho brang chen po shang mdor sbyar ba re zhig rdzogs so// //dge zhing bkra shis// //༄༅/ /dpal sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma rnam lnga'i gsung ma phyi gsar rnyed par du bskrun pa'i dkar chag dri bral me long zhes bya ba bzhugs so/ / ༄༅/ /bla ma dang lhag pa'i lha la gus pas phyag 'tshal lo/ /rgyal ba 'dren pa'i phul des thabs tshul du mas lus can rang gi sar/ /'god phyir da kyil 'khor gtsor bzhengs dbang rgyud man ngag gdams pa'i bka' drin can/ / gang dag mchog dang bdag la legs pa'i lam ston thugs rje'i mnga' bdag yongs | | mnyes pa gsum gyis byang chub thob kyang zhabs pad rigs kyi rgyan du bsten | | bskal bzang 'di yi ngo mtshar dge mtshan legs mthong phan bde'i tshal chen na/ /bde gshegs stong gi steng 'thung dbus na gang gi thugs bskyed zla med pa'i/ /'dab stong dkar po ches bsngags las byung zil dngar bcud bzang dam chos kyi/ /sbrang rtsi'i brtul zhugs 'dzin pa theg gsum rigs can dang bcas phyag gi yul/ /phyogs dus rnam 'dren kuna~X gyi mkhyen brtse nus pa'i ye shes gcig bsdus gar/ /theg gsum lam ston 'gro rnams dga~X' ba'i snyinga~X po~X mchog gi skur bzhengs pa/ /rnal 'byor dbang phyug sa skya pa zhes grags dkar snang bas srid pa'i khyon/ /gsal bar byed der do zla med ces spobs pa'i tshig gi rnga chen brdungs/ /bso~Xd nama~Xs ye shes tshogs chen yongs rdzogs 'jig rten gsal ba'i gnyen gcig pu/ /tshad med thugs bskyed rta bdun shugs kyi shar ri'i rtse~X mo~X nas drangs tshe/

/mkha' 'gro'i tshogs kyis bsngags pa'i gling bus rdo rje gdan bcas khyab byas shing*/ /chos nyid mngon gzigs bden dpang 'pho chen 'ja' lus gshegs der su mi dad/ /bsil ljongs 'chi med grong gi rnam rgyal pho brang dpal ldan sa skya ru/ /zab gsang rgyud sde rgya mtsho'i de nyid graga~Xs pa~X lha yi rnga bo che/ /rnam sad rgya~Xl bo kha che paṇa chen ston 'khor drung du nyer lhags tshe/ /dge mtsha~Xn bzang pos yid 'phrog phyag 'dab spyi bor snyim byas gang de rgyal/ /yon tan ku~Xn rdzogs gangs ri las 'ongs rigs pa'i gdong lnga'i spar khyim gyis/ /log smra'i spobs pa'i sgra skad che ldan 'phrog byed glang po'i klad 'gems te/ /dkar phyogs dga~X' ba'i rgyaXl mtsha~Xn bsgrengs las babs pa'i bshad sgrub rgyun bzang gis/ /dbyig 'dzin khyon yongs thub bstan sman ljongs bskrun mdzad bka' drin ji ltar gzhal/ /tshad meXd thugs smon chu gter las 'khrungs yon tan dkyil 'khor nya gang zhing*/ /ris medaX bstan 'gro'i mkha' la 'pha~Xgs pa~X gang gi blo~X gro~Xs bsil zer gyis/ /mgon medaX bod khams 'gro la gzhan gtses 'jigs pa'i tsha gdung kun bcom ste/ /zla medaX chos srid rgya~Xl mtsha~Xn mthor bsgrengs khyed kyi thugs rje deng 'dir dran/ / 'jam dbyangs mi yi srid par snang ba'i dpaXl/ /dpaXl ldan sa skya 'od gsal lha yi gduXng*/ /gduXng rabs tshar du dngar ba srid mtha'i baXr/ /baXr ma chad pa byon dang 'byon la 'dud/ /sa chen khyon yangs sa skya'i ring lugs kuXn/ /kuXn mkhyen rgyal ba'i dgongs pa ji bzhin duX/ /duX ma'i thabs kyis 'dzin skyong spel mdzad mkhaXn/ /mkhaXn brgyud bstan pa'i rtsa lag yongs la 'dud/ /bslab gsuXm yon tan mdzod la dbang 'byor zhing*/ /theg gsuXm dam pa'i chos kyi dbyangs snyan pa/ /srid gsuXm 'gro ba'i bla ma ris med kun/ /sgo gsuXm gus pa dang bcas phyag 'tshal te/

/bdag dang gzhan gyi phan 'de'i rtsa ba mchog /gcig tu dkar ba dam chos nyid lags phyir/ /bdag gis bgyi ba gzhan kun btang snyoms su/ /bzhag nas 'di na chos sbyin sgo 'phar phyes/ /dam chos bdag rkyen rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas las/ /byung ba'i ngag tshig dri ma med pa yi/ / bslab pa gsum ston tshad ma gsum gyis nges/ /thog mtha' bar du dge ba gang dag go /brjod don dbang gis rjod byed sde snod gsum/ /gdul bya la ltos theg pa che chung gnyis/ /rjod byed tsam gyi cha nas rgyal ba'i bka'/ /gsung rab yan lag bcu gnyis rnams su dbye/ /de don rab 'bring tha ma'i rtsom pa pos/ / rgyal bstan 'ba' zhig dbang byas chos skyob kyi/ /yon tan dang ldan ngan pa drug bral ba/ /de kun rgyal ba'i bka' dang gnyis su med/ /sras bcas 'dren pa yongs kyi ye shes sku/ /thugs rjes gzhan phyir mi yi zol gzung ba/ /'jam mgon sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga'i/ /gsung rab kun kyang de ltar ma lags sam | | rgya chen sdud dang zab mo rnam 'byed zhing*/ /'khrugs pa bsdebs pas rgyal ba'i dgongs pa kun/ /tshul bzhin gsal bar nus pa'i 'od stong can/ / smra ba'i nyi ma mchog rnams las gzhan su/ /'phags pa'i rnam thar so skye'i yul min pas/ /gsung kun bsdu ba'i go skabs su la mchis/ /'on kyang sngon tshe yul dus rkyen byas nas/ /par du ma 'khod 'ga' yang gsar du rnyed/ /de kun lhag bsam kho nas dbang byas te/ /phyogs gcig sdeb pa'i 'phrul gyi 'jug pa 'di | | bla ma'i bka' bzhin ji ltar bgyis pa'i rim/ /cung zad bkod pa'i ngag gi 'du byed spel/ /de la 'dir bdag gzhan sems can thams cad kyi gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi phan bde ma lus pa 'byung ba'i rgyu gcig pur gyur pa ni sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa kho na la rag las pa yin zhing*/ de yang 'jig rten 'dir dam chos rnal ma spyod pa'i dge slong la sogs pa phyogs gang la yod na der sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa dngos su yod pa yin/

de ltar min pa gzhan bstan pa'i ming 'dogs pa thams cad gzugs brnyan nam bstan pa'i mthun rkyen tsam yin gyi bstan pa dngos ni ma yin no/ /bstan pa dam pa'i chos de nyid phyin ci ma log pa zhig spyod dgos na rgyal ba'i bka' dri ma med pa dang*/ rjes 'jug mkhas pa rnams kyi bstan bcos tshad ldan dag la thos bsam yang dag par mdzad nas/ thos don nyams su blangs pa la brten gzod sa lam gyi yon tan gong 'phel gyi tshul du song nas/ rang gzhan sems can thams cad 'khor ba dang ngan song gi duḥkha las grol te thar pa dang thams cad mkhyen pa'i go 'phang rang nyid kyis thob cing*/ gzhan la yang sngon gyi thugs bskyed dang smon lam gyi dbang gis 'khor ba ma stong nam mkha' ma zhig gi bar du sems can gyi don bsam gyis mi khyab pa 'byung ba ni de bzhin gshegs pa kho na'i khyad chos lags so/ /de yang so skye tha mal las dang po pas rgyal ba'i bka' rgya che ba dang | zab pa dang*/ go rim 'khrugs pa dang*/ sgra ji bzhin pa dang*/ ji bzhin ma yin pa la sogs pa thams cad mi shes pas rjes 'jug mkhas pa rab chos nyid kyi bden pa mthong ba slob dpon 'phags pa klu sgrub dang*/ thogs med la sogs pa lta bu dang*/ 'bring yi dam lha'i zhal gzigs pa slob dpon zhi ba lha la sogs pa lta bu dang*/ tha ma rig pa'i gnas lnga la mkhas pa slob dpon ye shes snying po la sogs pa lta bus mdzad pa'i rgya bod mkhas pa'i bstan bcos tshad ldan dag la brten dgos so/ /de las ldog pa rig gnas phyogs re ba la blo kha tsam phyogs pa dag gis byas pa'am/ khyad par rang zhen 'khyog bshad kyi mig thur 'gyed pa dag gi rtsod ngag dang*/ rang nyid gang la'ang yid rten med pa lbu ba'i snying po la rdog 'cha' nas khungs med kyi gtam col smra ba dang*/ rgyu mtshan gang yang mi shes pa khyi rgan gzhan zer rjes snyegs kyi ku co 'don pa rnams kyi rtsom chos dag ngal ba chen pos spel yang dus dang dngos po gron pa'i rgyu las ci zhig mchis/

de ltar legs nyes 'byung ba'i rgyu mtshan shes par byas nas 'dir dpal sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma rnam pa lnga zhes mtshan nyi zla ltar yongs su grags pa rnams kyi gsung rab dri ma med pa sa bcu'i dbang phyug rnams kyi gsung dang gnyis su ma mchis pa dag sngo na gyi dus su sde dge chos kyi rgyal po yon mchod kyi gzhan phan rnam par dkar ba'i thugs bskyed kyi legs lam la brten/ phyogs mtha' dag nas 'tshol bsdu byas te gsung shin tu zab cing bka' rgya yod pa gsung ngag rin po che'i gzhung bshad sogs man ngag mang po lam skor phyi ma brgyad yan lag dang bcas pa dang*/ chos skyong gur zhal sogs kyi sgrub skor ches gnyan pa snyan brgyud kyi skor rnams phud pa'i thun mong ba rnams phyogs gcig tu bsdebs nas gsung 'bum shing par du bkod zin pa pod grangs bco lnga bzhugs kyang*/ yongs su rdzogs pa zhig bsdu ba ma nus pa ni dpal sa skya'i rje btsun gong ma lnga'i gsung rab rin po che'i par gyi sgo 'phar 'gyed pa'i dkar chag 'phrul gyi lde mig nyid du gsal zhing*/ gzhan yang tshad ma rigs pa'i gter gyi rang 'grel las/ gzhan grub mtha'i dbye ba kho bos byas pa'i grub mtha' rnam 'byed la sogs par shes par bya bas 'dir ma spros so | | zhes sogs dang*/ gzhan las kyang zhal 'phangs pa mang po zhig sde dge'i sa skya bka' 'bum par ma'i nang mi bzhugs shing*/ gzhan lta zhog 'jam dbyangs sa paṇa gyi gsung shin du grags che ba 'jig rten thun mong lugs kyi bstan bcos rnam pa gsum las/ par du dngos su 'khod pa ni legs par bshad pa rin po che'i gter gcig pu las gzhan gnyis mi 'dug de yang sde pa rin spungs pa ngag dbang 'jigs grags kyis/ lugs kyi bstan bcos legs par bshad pa dang*/ skyes bu'i rnam 'byed gzhon nu'i mgul pa'i rgyan/ /yang ni legs bshad nyi ma'i snying po ste/ /'jig rten mig tu bstan bcos snang ba gsum
